fit_basis.method: mean observed / mean predicted scale from one-step prediction_error scalar metrics

notes: METANET mass/density error is small; this applies a 1.064 freeway mass scale and a separate speed scale because mean speed was overpredicted by about 39.7 kph.
Kashani/local urban components were strongly overpredicted; queue and storage are scaled independently, then urban mass terms are recomputed from calibrated components.
Ramp queue was underpredicted by about 61x, which exceeds the adapter's safe component scale range; it is intentionally left for a separate ramp-arrival/queue-state calibration.
